messages.label: Step 0 (listening_phase1) progress trigger — advances to listening_phase2. Cond: service_id == 0xFFFF and sd_entry_count >= 1 and sd_entries[0].type == 0x01 and sd_entries[0].service_id == expected.service_id

Step 1 (listening_phase2) progress trigger — advances to listening_phase3. Cond: service_id == expected.service_id and message_type == 0x80 and method_id == 0x0015 and session_id == 0x0001 and return_code == 0x00 and pay…
Step 2 (listening_phase3) pass trigger — transitions to pass. Cond: service_id == expected.service_id and method_id == 0x0015 and session_id == 0x0002 and message_type == 0x81
